claim: KAITO's EPP is provided by the llm-d Router project, which builds on the base GWIE EPP with advanced scheduling plugins including KV-cache-aware routing, P/D disaggregation, and pluggable filters/scorers -- KAITO does not implement its own scheduling logic.
stance_target: downstream products reuse llm-d's router as-is rather than reimplementing scheduling logic
quoted_support: In KAITO, the EPP is provided by the llm-d Router project, which builds on the GWIE EPP with advanced scheduling plugins including KV cache-aware routing, prefill/decode (P/D) disaggregation, and pluggable filters/scorers.

claim: KAITO deploys the upstream llm-d-router-gateway Helm chart from oci://ghcr.io/llm-d/charts/llm-d-router-gateway pinned to v0.9.0, with the EPP container image pinned to mcr.microsoft.com/oss/v2/llm-d/llm-d-router-endpoint-picker:v0.9.0, via a Flux OCIRepository + HelmRelease managed by the InferenceSet controller.
stance_target: exact reuse mechanism: version-pinned upstream artifact consumption rather than forking
quoted_support: OCIRepository: points to the llm-d-router-gateway Helm chart URL: oci://ghcr.io/llm-d/charts/llm-d-router-gateway Version: v0.9.0 (pinned by KAITO)... The EPP image is pinned to mcr.microsoft.com/oss/v2/llm-d/llm-d-router-endpoint-picker:v0.9.0 to match the chart version.

claim: KAITO configures the EPP to listen on plaintext gRPC (router.epp.flags.secure-serving=false), requiring an Istio DestinationRule with tls.mode: DISABLE on the Gateway-to-EPP ext_proc connection.
stance_target: operational detail of the EPP's ext_proc transport security configuration in KAITO's deployment
quoted_support: In KAITO, the EPP is explicitly configured to listen on plaintext gRPC (router.epp.flags.secure-serving=false), so the DestinationRule sets tls.mode: DISABLE for the Istio Gateway → EPP ext_proc connection.

claim: KAITO's HTTPRoute targets the InferenceSet's InferencePool via a spec.endpointPickerRef field, the mechanism by which the Gateway API wiring points at the pluggable EPP backend.
stance_target: InferencePool/EPP wiring mechanism at the Gateway API layer
scope_conditions: Gateway API Inference Extension as consumed by KAITO
quoted_support: Create the HTTPRoute that targets the InferenceSet's InferencePool (via .spec.endpointPickerRef) and defines the routing matchers used by the Gateway.

claim: Optional Body-Based Routing (BBR), from the upstream kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api-inference-extension repo, extracts the model name from OpenAI-style JSON request bodies and injects an X-Gateway-Model-Name header, enabling multi-model routing without client-side changes.
stance_target: model-aware routing mechanism independent of client behavior
scope_conditions: KAITO optional BBR deployment, chart registry.k8s.io/gateway-api-inference-extension/charts/body-based-routing v1.3.0
quoted_support: BBR automatically extracts model names from OpenAI-style API requests and injects an X-Gateway-Model-Name header to the inference request, enabling model routing without modifying client code.
